criteria.bypass_warning: A heading `WARNING: Claude Code running in Bypass Permissions mode`, an explanation that Claude Code will not ask for approval and `By proceeding, you accept all responsibility ...`, then two unnumbered options: `No, exit` first and `Yes, I accept` second, usually followed by `Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel`. The menu is still waiting for a choice.
criteria.other: Anything else: a different prompt (workspace trust, Chrome extension, permission to run a command or edit a file); normal conversation or the status bar merely mentioning bypass permissions; or the warning only in old scrollback while the session has moved on to a normal input box below it.

question.instructions: The text is the screen of a Claude Code terminal. Decide whether it is currently showing the startup warning `WARNING: Claude Code running in Bypass Permissions mode`, still waiting for the user to pick an option.
